idea.title: Urubu do Ver-o-Peso
idea.text: Ver-o-Peso, Belém: um urubu pousa no topete como se fosse poste e os dois encaram a lente

script.title: Urubu do Ver-o-Peso
script.premise: No cais do Ver-o-Peso, em Belém, Gersinho faz o passo brega na beira do rio; um urubu desce pela borda de cima e pousa no alto do topete como se fosse um poste, e os dois ficam parados, sérios, encarando a lente.
script.gag_without_sound: um urubu pousa no topete como se fosse poste e os dois encaram a câmera com a mesma cara

location.place: cais do mercado Ver-o-Peso, beira da baía do Guajará

camera.height: altura do peito, a 3 m, no calçamento do cais

beats.action: na beira do cais, com o mercado de ferro azul no fundo, faz o passo brega: quadril pendular e indicador subindo e descendo no tempo
beats.extras: peixeiro arruma peixe na banca, dois fregueses passam, urubus no telhado do mercado ao fundo

beats.action: um urubu desce pela borda de cima e pousa no alto do topete; ele fica parado, sério, e os dois encaram a lente

script.end_state: urubu preto empoleirado no alto do topete, asas fechadas, cabeça virada para a lente; Gersinho sério com dedo pra cima, os dois encarando a câmera

script.start_frame: Gersinho de corpo inteiro na beira do cais do Ver-o-Peso, de frente para a câmera, dedo pra cima, mão na barriga, topete inteiro visível, mercado de ferro azul e barcos ao fundo
script.end_frame: urubu preto empoleirado no alto do topete, asas fechadas, cabeça para a lente; Gersinho sério, dedo pra cima

music.trend_sound_hint: brega paraense clássico (tecnobrega lento) em alta

script.caption: Em Belém o Gerson é ponto turístico. E poleiro.
script.originality_note: primeira contraparte animal; o topete vira poleiro e o bicho faz o deadpan junto. Belém é a capital do brega, primeira locação no Norte.
script.risks: o urubu entrar pelas costas dele ou pousar no ombro; o topete entortar com o peso; ele olhar para cima. Conferir no painel 3 o urubu vindo da borda de cima e no end frame as asas fechadas no alto do topete.

en.gag_sentence: On the riverside dock of the Ver-o-Peso market in Belém he does his signature brega step until a black vulture glides down from the top edge of the frame and lands on the very top of his rigid pompadour, and the two of them stare into the lens.
en.location: the stone riverside dock of the Ver-o-Peso market in Belém: the blue cast-iron market hall with pointed turrets in the background, small wooden fishing boats moored at the river edge, a fish stall under a canvas awning, black vultures standing on the market roof, humid overcast morning
en.location_map: Frame-left: a fish stall under a canvas awning with one fishmonger. Center: him standing on the stone dock; behind him, 20 m away, the blue cast-iron market hall with turrets, three black vultures standing on its roof edge. Frame-right: the river edge with two moored wooden boats. Foreground: wet stone paving.
en.position: standing on the stone dock, centered, chest square to the lens, full body visible from shoes to the top of the pompadour, the top of the pompadour 10% below the top edge of the frame
en.signature_pose: left hand flat on his belly, right index finger raised beside his head, feet together
en.extras_tasks: one fishmonger at the stall lays fish on crushed ice looking at his hands, two shoppers with plastic bags walk from frame-left to frame-right along the dock looking ahead
en.props: exactly one fish stall at frame-left and exactly two moored wooden boats at frame-right; three vultures stay standing on the distant market roof
en.hands: He has exactly two hands: left hand flat on his belly, right hand with the index finger raised.

stages.text: He holds the signature pose from the start frame on the stone dock; breathing lifts the chest, one slow blink.
stages.facing: chest 0° to the lens, face 0° to the lens, eyes on the lens
stages.end_state: same pose, eyes into the lens.

stages.text: Real-time, at 95 BPM: he shifts his weight onto his left foot, heel first, then onto his right foot; his hips sway once to frame-left and once to frame-right on the beat; his raised right index finger moves up and down twice on the beat; his left hand stays flat on his belly.
stages.facing: chest within 30° of the lens while the hips sway, face 0° to the lens, eyes on the lens
stages.end_state: feet together, finger raised, chest square to the lens.

stages.text: A black vulture glides down from the top edge of the frame, wings spread, travelling from frame-top toward frame-center in front of the market hall, and lands on the very top of the pompadour, its feet gripping the crest; it folds its wings; the pompadour keeps its outline under the weight; he keeps the pose, eyes on the lens.
stages.facing: chest 0° to the lens, face 0° to the lens, eyes on the lens

counterpart.position: off-screen, enters from the top edge of the frame
counterpart.limb: its whole body, wings spread, feet first
counterpart.vector: travels frame-top to frame-center and stops perched on the top of the pompadour

stages.end_state: the vulture perched on top of the pompadour, wings folded.

stages.text: Everything holds: the black vulture stays perched on top of the pompadour, wings folded, and turns its head to the lens; he stares into the lens, finger raised; one slow blink from each. The final frame matches the end frame.
stages.facing: chest 0° to the lens, face 0° to the lens, eyes on the lens

counterpart.position: perched on the top of the pompadour, centered above his head
counterpart.facing: body 0° to the lens, head 0° to the lens
counterpart.task: stays perched, wings folded, one slow blink

stages.end_state: vulture perched on the pompadour, both faces toward the lens, deadpan.

en.end_change: a black vulture stands perched on the very top of the rigid black pompadour, wings folded, its head turned toward the lens; the pompadour keeps its outline; he stands in the signature pose, deadpan, eyes on the lens
en.props_lock: Exactly one vulture on him (from 6.5s on); three other vultures stay on the distant market roof the whole clip.
en.lighting: Humid overcast morning light from the open sky over the river, soft and even, light haze, 6000K.
